about.name: Roshan Nehru
intro: Roshan Nehru’s journey is that of a self-taught, young Indian calisthenics athlete who built everything from scratch — no inheritance, no shortcuts, only discipline and relentless work. With over 10 years of intensive training, he is a 2x National Champion and World Battle of the Year Winner, known for extreme feats such as completing 3,270 pull-ups in 24 hours.

Starting calisthenics at a young age, Roshan quickly became India’s youngest professional freestyle athlete. His path has been defined by overcoming injuries, mastering unique movement skills, and developing exceptional mental toughness. Today, he coaches athletes worldwide through online 1-on-1 training and workshops, inspiring others to pursue real strength, consistency, and long-term mastery in both body and mind.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes. Programs are scaled based on your current strength and experience level.

faqs.question: Do I need gym equipment?
faqs.answer: A pull-up bar is recommended, but most training can be done with minimal equipment.

faqs.question: Is coaching fully online?
faqs.answer: Yes. Coaching is delivered online with personalized plans, feedback, and regular check-ins.
